description: Golden retrieval set for the OIB corpus. Labels are Punkte, not chunks, and are expanded to (file_name, page) units through fixtures/punkt_index.json at load time. Every German question has an English sibling with IDENTICAL qrels, so a measured language gap is a retrieval defect rather than a labelling artefact. calibration_pending is true on every entry: the labels are read from the corpus, but the grades have not yet been reviewed by a second Austrian building-law reader.

entries.question: Wie lang darf die Gehweglänge von jeder Stelle eines Raumes bis zum Ausgang ins Freie oder zum Treppenhaus höchstens sein?

entries.question: Wie groß muss die Breite des Fluchtwegs bei einem Hauptgang mindestens sein?
entries.provenance: shared/cards/schemas.json: DimensionDiagramCard names 'corridor width' as a clearance question class and warns about the Stocklichte-vs-Durchgangslichte misread that makes the wording of this need worth testing three ways.
entries.label_method: German morphology variant of de-fluchtwegbreite with IDENTICAL qrels. aiq_agent.common.german_text states that neither backend splits closed compounds, so 'Fluchtwegbreite' is not reachable from 'Fluchtweg'; these three wordings of one need turn that documented limitation into a measured spread.
entries.notes: Read p6 of data/oib/oib-rl_4_ausgabe_mai_2023.pdf: Punkt 2.4.1 requires 1,20 m lichte Durchgangsbreite for Hauptgänge (1,00 m in the listed cases), Punkt 2.4.3 carries Tabelle 1 for lichte Treppenlaufbreite, and Punkt 2.4.5 adds 10 cm per further 10 persons above 120 — the width question is not answerable from 2.4.1 alone once occupancy is known.
